title: Bonsai Automata
game_overview: An idle zen simulation featuring automated power and irrigation grids to grow bonsais to level 100, combined with reaction-based wilderness excursions.
winning_condition: Successfully discover and cultivate the rarest botanical specimen in the wilderness—the Mythic Golden Ginkgo Bonsai—to Level 100 Mastery in your automated sanctuary.
losing_condition: None. The game is a relaxing zen experience with no fail state or game over. When the expedition backpack reaches maximum capacity, the player simply cannot carry additional items and returns to the starting campsite portal to transport all gathered resources back to the sanctuary.

controls.action: Dig action in the radial shovel minigame during excursions.

controls.input: W/A/S/D or Arrow Keys / Virtual Joystick
controls.action: Move the botanist explorer across the excursion overworld.
Select bonsais to prune, purchase machinery upgrades, and manage inventory slots.
Open inventory and equipment backpack screen.
Switch between Greenhouse Sanctuary and Wilderness Excursion view.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Immediate Ghost Footprint Initialization: The ghost placement silhouette instantly resolves and renders on the player's active grid plot upon closing the deployment menu on frame one, eliminating the need to leave and re-enter the grid. 2. Dedicated Arrow-Key Preview Rotation: Arrow keys (Left/Right/Up/Down), Q/R keys, and Shoulder Bumpers (LB/RB) directly toggle footprint orientation between horizontal (3x1) and vertical (1x3) during placement preview before reaching window scroll interceptors. 3. Architectural Depth Z-Layering: Torii Gates utilize two-tier depth rendering: the ground layer (pebble pathway and foundation post stones) renders below the player, while the elevated vermilion pillars and overhead Kasagi roof crossbeam render above the player avatar, allowing the player to naturally walk through and underneath the archway with genuine depth perspective.
sections.summary: Immediate Ghost Placement Telemetry, Dedicated Arrow Rotation Capture, and Architectural Z-Layering for Torii Gates.
